title: ever TOVE|See-through Lace Sleeveless High Stretch Wedding Guest Dress
descriptionHtml:
This V-neck cap-sleeve A-line midi cocktail dress is a go-to choice for wedding guests who want to look polished and feel comfortable from ceremony to reception. The fitted bodice and defined waist create a flattering shape, while the midi-length skirt moves easily for dinners, photos, and dancing. Perfect for weddings, rehearsal dinners, bridal showers, cocktail parties, and other semi-formal occasions, just add heels and a clutch for an instantly event-ready look.


Fit: Please refer to size chart.


Length: Midi.


Sleeve Style: Sleeveless.


Closure: Back zipper.


Undergarments: It is not padded, with lining.


Fabric:The garment comprises lace.


Stretch: Fabric is high stretch.
